title: Manual or FAQ
description: A user manual or FAQ written as one JSON document, for @bindpress/manual. Pages are a flat list in reading order; `level` says how deep each page sits. Fields not listed here are allowed and ignored. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (the first page is level 0, a page sits at most one level below the page before it, page ids are unique, question ids are unique within a page) are checked by validateManual().

kind.description: manual: numbered chapters, drawn as PDF-style sheets. faq: questions that open and close, drawn as a help centre.

title.description: Shown on the cover (manual) or at the top (FAQ).

version.description: Free text, such as "Version 2.1". Shown in the footer and cover.

updated.description: The day it was last updated, written YYYY-MM-DD, or "".

numbering.description: on: chapters and sections are numbered 1, 1.2, 1.2.1, and figures 1.1, 1.2.

pages.description: Chapters, sections and topics in reading order.

id.description: Unique in the manual. Part of the page's address: #<render id>-<page id>.

level.description: 0 = chapter (or FAQ topic), 1 = section under the page above, and so on.

text.description: Plain text; line breaks are kept. A list has one item per line; a table one row per line, cells split by |, the first row the header; a question holds its answer here.

id.description: Optional. A stable address for the answer, unique within the page. Without it, questions are numbered by their place (q1, q2, ...).

fileUrl.description: The image address: http(s), relative, or data:image/(png|jpeg|gif|webp|svg+xml). Anything else is not shown.

fileId.description: Your own reference to the file. Not used by the renderer.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for people who cannot see it.
